tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /rdo rje rnam par 'joms pa'i gsang sgrub zhes bya ba bzhugs so// na mo gu ru/ ye shes kyi mkha' 'gro ma ni gu ma'i gdams pa la/ dpal rdo rje rnam par 'joms pa'i gsang sgrub nyams su len par 'dod pas/ tho rangs snga bar langs te/ skyabs su 'gro ba dang sems bskyed pa byas la/ rkang pa gnyis bsnol te tsog pur bya/ lag pa gnyis bsnol te sbe sha gnyis la 'jus/ gru mo gnyis pus mo gnyis kyi steng du dgab/ de nas rdo rje'i ting nge 'dzin la bzhugs so/ /zhes gsungs pa'i don la/ rnam par mi rtog pa'i ting nge 'dzin la mnyam par bzhag go /des bar chad mi 'byung zhing byin rlabs che ba'i dgos pa yod gsung ngo / /de nas dbyibs bum pa ni lus kyi 'khrul 'khor lnga bca' ba'o/ /snang ba bum pa ni rang gi lus bum pa mngon no/ /rkang pa zhabs/ ske yan chad kha/ rdo rje nor bu mchur bsam/ lar gzugs su snang tshad thams cad bum par bsgoms pas chog pa yin gsung / dmigs rten bum pa ni/ rang bum par sgom pa'i nang thams cad gzungs kyis khengs par bsams pa'i steng du/ dpal rdo rje rnam par 'joms pa sku mdog mthing kha/ zhabs brkyangs bskums phyag g.yas rdo rje/ g.yon sdigs …dril bu mdzub/ spyan gsum pa/ mche ba gtsigs pa/ khro bo'i rgyan sna tshogs kyis brgyan zhing / me dpung gi klong na bzhugs par bskyed do/ /de nas gzungs bzlas pa dang / rang steng gi lha dang nang gi gzungs thams cad las sngags kyi rang sgra dang / ye shes kyi bdud rtsi'i chu rgyun 'bab par bsam la/ gzungs tshar bdun nam/ nyi shu rtsa gcig gam/ brgya rtsa brgyad bzlas/ 'jog tsa na steng gi lha bdud rtsir zhu nas/ nang gi gzungs la thim/ gzungs kyang bdud rtsir zhu bar bsam la/ rang gi mchus khrus bya ba'am/ gzhan la yang sbyin no/ /gzhan gyi gzungs chog lta bu byas na yang / maṇḍal bum pa dang bcas la/ bum pa la yang bdag bskyed bzhin byas la bzlas so/

/'jog tsa na/ rang dang bum pa'i chu gnyis bsres nas 'thung ba dang / khrus byed du gzhug gsung ngo / /nyams grib chen po phog pa la/ 'di min pa gzhan gang gis kyang mi sel ba 'dug gsung ngo / /ye shes kyi mkha' 'gro ma ni gu ma'i khyad par gyi gdams pa/ dpal rdo rje rnam par 'joms pa'i gsang sgrub chos rje sangs rgyas ston pa'i gsung bzhin bris pa'o/ /rdzogs so// //athi+-itsha/ 'di'i brgyud pa ni/ rdo rje 'chang gis ḍā ki ma la gnang / des bla ma shangs pa la/ des rmog lcog pa/ skyer sgang pa/ gnyan ston/ sangs rgyas ston pa/ mkhas grub chos rje/ rdos ston sangs rgyas/ rol pa rdo rje/ skyes mchog a nan chos rje/ shes rab bzang po/ don yod rgyal mtshan/ des bdag yon tan dpal 'byung la gnang ba'o// //ath-i+-iitsha// //༄༅/ /rdo rje rnam par 'joms pa'i gsang sgrub zhes bya ba bzhugs so// na mo gu ru/ ye shes kyi mkha' 'gro ma ni gu ma'i gdams pa la/ dpal rdo rje rnam par 'joms pa'i gsang sgrub nyams su len par 'dod pas/ tho rangs snga bar langs te/ skyabs su 'gro ba dang sems bskyed pa byas la/ rkang pa gnyis bsnol te tsog pur bya/ lag pa gnyis bsnol te sbe sha gnyis la 'jus/ gru mo gnyis pus mo gnyis kyi steng du dgab/ de nas rdo rje'i ting nge 'dzin la bzhugs so/ /zhes gsungs pa'i don la/ rnam par mi rtog pa'i ting nge 'dzin la mnyam par bzhag go /des bar chad mi 'byung zhing byin rlabs che ba'i dgos pa yod gsung ngo / /de nas dbyibs bum pa ni lus kyi 'khrul 'khor lnga bca' ba'o/ /snang ba bum pa ni rang gi lus bum pa mngon no/ /rkang pa zhabs/ ske yan chad kha/ rdo rje nor bu mchur bsam/ lar gzugs su snang tshad thams cad bum par bsgoms pas chog pa yin gsung / dmigs rten bum pa ni/ rang bum par sgom pa'i nang thams cad gzungs kyis khengs par bsams pa'i steng du/ dpal rdo rje rnam par 'joms pa sku mdog mthing kha/

zhabs brkyangs bskums phyag g.yas rdo rje/ g.yon sdigs …dril bu mdzub/ spyan gsum pa/ mche ba gtsigs pa/ khro bo'i rgyan sna tshogs kyis brgyan zhing / me dpung gi klong na bzhugs par bskyed do/ /de nas gzungs bzlas pa dang / rang steng gi lha dang nang gi gzungs thams cad las sngags kyi rang sgra dang / ye shes kyi bdud rtsi'i chu rgyun 'bab par bsam la/ gzungs tshar bdun nam/ nyi shu rtsa gcig gam/ brgya rtsa brgyad bzlas/ 'jog tsa na steng gi lha bdud rtsir zhu nas/ nang gi gzungs la thim/ gzungs kyang bdud rtsir zhu bar bsam la/ rang gi mchus khrus bya ba'am/ gzhan la yang sbyin no/ /gzhan gyi gzungs chog lta bu byas na yang / maṇḍal bum pa dang bcas la/ bum pa la yang bdag bskyed bzhin byas la bzlas so/ /'jog tsa na/ rang dang bum pa'i chu gnyis bsres nas 'thung ba dang / khrus byed du gzhug gsung ngo / /nyams grib chen po phog pa la/ 'di min pa gzhan gang gis kyang mi sel ba 'dug gsung ngo / /ye shes kyi mkha' 'gro ma ni gu ma'i khyad par gyi gdams pa/ dpal rdo rje rnam par 'joms pa'i gsang sgrub chos rje sangs rgyas ston pa'i gsung bzhin bris pa'o/ /rdzogs so// //athi+-itsha/ 'di'i brgyud pa ni/ rdo rje 'chang gis ḍā ki ma la gnang / des bla ma shangs pa la/ des rmog lcog pa/ skyer sgang pa/ gnyan ston/ sangs rgyas ston pa/ mkhas grub chos rje/ rdos ston sangs rgyas/ rol pa rdo rje/ skyes mchog a nan chos rje/ shes rab bzang po/ don yod rgyal mtshan/ des bdag yon tan dpal 'byung la gnang ba'o// //athi+-itsha// //༄༅/ /rdo rje rnam par 'joms pa'i gsang sgrub zhes bya ba bzhugs so// na mo gu ru/ ye shes kyi mkha' 'gro ma ni gu ma'i gdams pa la/ dpal rdo rje rnam par 'joms pa'i gsang sgrub nyams su len par 'dod pas/ tho rangs snga bar langs te/ skyabs su 'gro ba dang sems bskyed pa byas la/ rkang pa gnyis bsnol te tsog pur bya/
